Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship - Research Students

Provider: MEXT

Degree: Research students eligible for admission to a master's program or a doctoral program at a Japanese graduate school

Field of study: Major in field of specialty at a graduate school including Computer Science

Funding Type: Scholarship of JPY 144,000 per month. Tuition exempted. Round-trip travel expenses provided.

Eligible Nationalities: apply with a recommendation from a Japanese embassy in your country; confirm the latest application guidelines

Country of study: Japan

Eligibility criteria: applicants are recruited and screened by a Japanese embassy; university recommendation also possible

Deadline: See the latest application guidelines for the current deadline
